name: Southsea Freebooters
summary: Along the Merchant Coast south of Ratchet, Southsea Freebooters strike goblin trading vessels. Gazlowe hires adventurers to attack their camp and curb the raids.

sections.title: A Thorn in Gazlowe's Side
sections.body: Ratchet's trade suffers from pirates on the Merchant Coast. The port sits in central Kalimdor, where merchant vessels travel between Kalimdor and the eastern continents. South of town, Southsea Freebooters hold a fortified beach camp. From there, they attack goblin cargo ships arriving and departing, cutting into profits and disrupting local shipping lanes.

sections.title: Neglect from Undermine
sections.body: Gazlowe blames the pirates and the Steamwheedle Cartel's naval leaders. The Trade Princes have spent immense sums on defensive fleets, yet Vice Admiral Grezzlik has failed to patrol the waters effectively. Frustrated by Undermine's slow response, Gazlowe hires independent mercenaries to thin the pirate brigands and cannoneers.

faq.answer: The Southsea Freebooters are pirates who operate across the southern oceans and the Great Sea. In the Barrens, they hold an armed beach camp south of Ratchet and raid merchant ships, plundering trade goods bound for Kalimdor.

faq.q: Why does Gazlowe care so much about these pirates?
faq.answer: Gazlowe oversees Ratchet's port for the Steamwheedle Cartel. Each merchant ship the Freebooters intercept or plunder cuts into cartel revenue and weakens Ratchet's reputation as a secure trading haven.

faq.q: Where is the pirate camp located?
faq.answer: The Southsea camp lies along the Merchant Coast, down the shoreline south of Ratchet. Fortified tents, beached dinghies, and artillery positions manned by Southsea Cannoneers mark the camp.
Vice Admiral Grezzlik oversees the Steamwheedle Cartel's trade fleets and protects its sea lanes. Gazlowe considers him ineffective, given the pirates operating brazenly off the Barrens coast.

faq.q: What happens after culling the camp?
faq.answer: Culling the camp's defenders solves only part of the problem. After the brigands and cannoneers are routed, Gazlowe turns to tracking down the valuable cargo they hijacked, leading to investigations into his missing shipments.

faq.q: Are the Southsea Freebooters affiliated with the Alliance or Horde?
faq.answer: No. The Southsea Freebooters operate outside both factions and prey on Alliance vessels, Horde supply craft, and neutral goblin freighters alike.

angles.text: As a rogue, you find opportunities for cutpurses in the Southsea Freebooters' camp, if you can slip past alert watchmen and heavy coastal artillery.
As a member of the Horde, you rely on Ratchet as a vital resupply corridor in Kalimdor. Clear sea routes protect supplies moving inland across the Barrens.
